interface.shortDescription: A shared room for Codex users
interface.longDescription: CarbonChat is a shared, chronological room for people working with AI. Read, chat, react, and explore up to five selected Highlights that link to original messages. Sign in with GitHub and review the current terms, privacy notice and 18+ confirmation; room access also depends on admission and account standing. Choose a nickname and preset avatar when you want to post. Ordinary room chat does not call your Agent. Optional manual translation sends selected text to your current linked Agent, adds a visible request to that conversation, and uses its allowance. The Lobby is not confidential or end-to-end encrypted: members can read, copy or screenshot messages. The operator's OpenAI assistant, dot, may separately review necessary new Lobby messages from the previous 24 hours for safety and Highlights. See the Privacy Notice.
capabilities: Open the full Community room UI
Read and reply to room messages
